_comment: The Mexican base preparations, fixed before any recipe was written so the dish files and the base file agree on ids. Agent A writes every one of these. Dish files point at them through components. A dish needing a base not listed here writes it itself under curated_mx_base_<slug>, and duplicates are settled at merge.

bases.name: Masa de Nixtamal
bases.what: Fresh masa dough from dried field corn cooked and soaked with cal, then ground. Also give the masa harina route in the steps.

bases.name: Masa para Tamales
bases.what: Masa beaten with lard, broth, baking powder and salt until it floats.

bases.name: Tortillas de Maíz
bases.what: Corn tortillas pressed from masa and cooked on a comal. Component: the masa.

bases.name: Tortillas de Harina
bases.what: Sonoran-style wheat flour tortillas with lard.

bases.name: Totopos
bases.what: Corn tortillas cut in wedges and fried or baked crisp. Component: corn tortillas.

bases.name: Tostadas (Shells)
bases.what: Whole corn tortillas fried or baked flat and crisp. Component: corn tortillas.

bases.name: Bolillo
bases.what: Crusty Mexican white roll, used for tortas and molletes.

bases.name: Telera
bases.what: Soft flat torta roll with two scored lines.

bases.name: Salsa Roja Asada
bases.what: Roasted tomato, chile and garlic table salsa.

bases.name: Salsa Verde Cocida
bases.what: Boiled tomatillo and serrano salsa.

bases.name: Salsa Verde Cruda
bases.what: Raw tomatillo, serrano, cilantro and onion salsa, often with avocado for taquerías.

bases.name: Pico de Gallo
bases.what: Chopped tomato, onion, serrano, cilantro, lime and salt.

bases.name: Salsa Taquera de Chile de Árbol
bases.what: Thin, hot chile de árbol and tomatillo salsa from the taquería.

bases.name: Salsa Macha
bases.what: Veracruz dried chile, garlic and seed oil salsa.

bases.name: Salsa Ranchera
bases.what: Cooked tomato and serrano sauce for huevos rancheros.

bases.name: Chiltomate
bases.what: Yucatecan roasted tomato and habanero sauce for papadzules and huevos motuleños.

bases.name: Guacamole
bases.what: Avocado mashed in a molcajete with onion, serrano, cilantro, lime and salt.

bases.name: Salsa de Guajillo
bases.what: Red guajillo chile sauce, the base of red enchiladas and pozole rojo.

bases.name: Salsa de Jitomate para Entomatadas
bases.what: Smooth cooked tomato sauce for entomatadas.

bases.name: Adobo de Chiles Secos
bases.what: Ancho and guajillo chile paste with vinegar and spices, a marinade for meats.

bases.name: Recado Rojo
bases.what: Yucatecan achiote paste with sour orange, for cochinita pibil.

bases.name: Mole Poblano
bases.what: The sauce only.

bases.name: Mole Negro Oaxaqueño
bases.what: The sauce only.

bases.name: Mole Verde
bases.what: The sauce only, pumpkin seed and green herb based.

bases.name: Mole Amarillo
bases.what: The sauce only, thickened with masa.

bases.name: Mole Coloradito
bases.what: The sauce only.

bases.name: Pipián Verde
bases.what: The sauce only, pumpkin seed based.

bases.name: Caldo de Pollo (Stock)
bases.what: Plain chicken stock with onion, garlic and herbs, strained, used as the liquid in other recipes. Caldo de Pollo the soup is a separate dish.

bases.name: Pollo Deshebrado
bases.what: Poached and shredded chicken for tacos, enchiladas, flautas and tamales. A main-dish component, not a side.

bases.name: Frijoles de la Olla
bases.what: Pot beans with onion, garlic and epazote. A true side.

bases.name: Frijoles Refritos
bases.what: Pot beans fried and mashed in lard. A true side. Component: frijoles de la olla.

bases.name: Arroz Rojo
bases.what: Mexican red rice. A true side.

bases.name: Arroz Blanco
bases.what: Mexican white rice. A true side.

bases.name: Arroz Verde
bases.what: Green rice with poblano and cilantro. A true side.

bases.name: Cebolla Morada Encurtida
bases.what: Yucatecan pickled red onion with sour orange or lime and habanero.

bases.name: Chiles en Escabeche
bases.what: Pickled jalapeños with carrot and onion.

bases.name: Crema Mexicana
bases.what: Cultured cream made at home from cream and a little cultured buttermilk or yogurt.

bases.name: Queso Fresco
bases.what: Fresh pressed farmer cheese made at home from milk with rennet or acid.

bases.name: Manteca (Rendered Lard)
bases.what: Pork fat rendered at home.

bases.name: Chorizo Mexicano
bases.what: Fresh red chorizo from ground pork, chiles, vinegar and spices. A main-dish component, not a side.

bases.name: Cajeta
bases.what: Goat milk caramel, slowly reduced.

bases.name: Miel de Piloncillo
bases.what: Piloncillo syrup with cinnamon, for buñuelos, capirotada and café de olla.
